attempts.certificate: (1)“必然非p”蕴含“可能非p”，两句可以同真；在“必然p”时两句又都为假，因此可以同假，属D。(2)同理，“必然p”蕴含“可能p”，且在“必然非p”时两句都为假，也属D。

judges.reason: Both pairs can be true together and can be false together. In (1), 必然非p implies 可能非p, so both are true when 非p is necessary; both are false when p is necessary. In (2), 必然p implies 可能p, so both are true when p is necessary; both are false when 非p is necessary. Thus both pairs satisfy relation D, matching the canonical answer.
judges.depth_evidence: For each pair, two checks are necessary: construct a case where both statements are true and a case where both are false. The entailments 必然非p→可能非p and 必然p→可能p are consistent with both cases.
judges.explanation_evidence: The supplied certificate correctly identifies the relevant necessity-to-possibility implications and gives valid cases for joint truth and joint falsity for both pairs.
